title: Canonical terminal germ image
statement: Let K be a field, Ks a separable closure, and Omega an algebraically closed extension containing Ks over K with the compatible scalar tower. Let T be terminal in the small etale site of Spec K, and x its geometric lift. Let E be an equivalence from abelian sheaves to discrete continuous integer Galois representations, with an additive natural stalk isomorphism i satisfying the lift-change action formula of the supplied representation. For every sheaf F and every vector v in E(F), v is Galois invariant if and only if v is the image of a section in F(T) under the germ at x followed by i_F inverse.

proof.text: The terminal etale object T has an inverse to its structural map to Spec K: form the unique map j from the identity etale object and use terminality to prove T.hom followed by j.left is the identity. Since Spec K has one point, T.left is a subsingleton, and its supplied geometric lift x exhibits nonemptiness.

Forget F to its underlying sheaf of sets Fset. The forgetful functor on AddCommGrpCat preserves filtered colimits, including the smaller universe of the geometric point; Mathlib preservesFilteredColimitsOfSize_shrink and Point.sheafFiberCompIso give the canonical equivalence e between the Type-valued and abelian stalks. Point.toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberCompIso_hom_app proves that e preserves each germ. Transport the supplied representation action through i.hom, i.inv and e to a function rho on the underlying stalk. The hypothesis hi and the germ comparison give the change-of-lift formula for rho.

For an invariant vector v, the constant family of underlying stalk elements e.inverse(i.hom(v)) is covariant under rho, by the invariant equality and the inverse identities for i and e. Apply [lem-exc-field-equivariant-germs-one-point-selected-lift] to Fset, the nonempty one-point T, its supplied lift x, rho and this constant family. It provides a section z whose underlying germ is e.inverse(i.hom(v)). The germ comparison and the inverse identities transport its abelian germ through i.inv to v. The cited theorem treats arbitrary algebraically closed Omega, reducing internally to its relative algebraic closure while preserving germ formulas.

Conversely, extend g in Gal(Ks/K) to tau on Omega by [lem-exc-galois-automorphism-extension]. The extension fixes the geometric base map because it is a K-algebra automorphism. The inverse j.left to the terminal structural map expresses the lift x.left as the base map followed by j.left, so changing x by Spec tau leaves it unchanged. Apply hi to the terminal section and that same lift. Injectivity of i.hom and its inverse identities yield rho(g) fixing the terminal germ transported through i.inv. This proves invariance for every g.

    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (T : (Spec (.of K)).Etale) (hT : Limits.IsTerminal T)
    (E : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ≌
      Rep.DiscreteContinuousRep.{0, u, u + 1} ℤ (Gal(Ks/K)))
    (i : E.functor ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι _ ⋙ Rep.RepToAction ℤ (Gal(Ks/K)) ⋙
      Action.forget (ModuleCat.{u + 1} ℤ) (Gal(Ks/K)) ⋙
      forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} ℤ) AddCommGrpCat ≅
      (pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).sheafFiber)
    (hi : ∀ (F : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
      (hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
        τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
      (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale)
      (x x' : (pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).fiber.obj X)
      (hx : x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left)
      (z : F.obj.obj (op X)),
      (i.hom.app F) ((E.functor.obj F).obj.ρ g
        ((i.inv.app F) ((pointSmallEtale
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).toPresheafFiber X x F.obj z))) =
      (pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).toPresheafFiber
        X x' F.obj z)
    (x : (pointSmallEtale
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).fiber.obj T)
    : ∀ (F : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (v : (E.functor.obj F).obj.V),
      v ∈ (@Representation.invariants ℤ _ (E.functor.obj F).obj.V _ _
        (E.functor.obj F).obj.hV1 (E.functor.obj F).obj.hV2 (E.functor.obj F).obj.ρ) ↔
      ∃ z : F.obj.obj (op T),
      (i.inv.app F) ((pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).toPresheafFiber T x F.obj z) = v
